title: Present experiments cannot yet support or reject the model

statements.text: Khrennikov recognizes that experimental research in quantum physics, neurophysiology, cognitive science and psychology is not yet advanced enough to support or reject the quantum-like model of cognition.

sources.quote: the present level of experimental research in quantum physics, neurophysiology, cognitive science, and psychology is not high enough to support (or to reject) our quantum-like (QL) model of cognition
